reviewer: Separate prospective method reviewer; nonblind, same-source AI
decision_explanation: The fixed whole corridor is tractable as a finite annotation inventory, subject to complete actual reading coverage and the narrow recording/reconciliation safeguards below. This is not approval of any fragment identity, historical ordinate, physical uncertainty or comparison metric.

scope.allowed: Method text and prior completed-stage report only; write this review.
scope.not_read: No new or old source images, annotation records, raw RGB contents, or new historical outputs were read for this review.
scope.authority: Main/user AGENTS and full investigation CHARTER remain controlling. The numerical contract and current human-review gate were reread. Axis/legend confirmation authorizes preparation, not selected-coordinate or physical acceptance.
scope.artifact_class: Working research critique; no source or frozen evidence alteration and no scientific, human, engine or legal-state promotion.

bounds.coordinate_convention: Zero-based native pixel cells; inclusive integer bounds.
bounds.interpretation: The 180 entries are route-column records, not 180 independent stroke fragments or observations of physical response.

genuine_progress.assessment: This expands from fourteen fragment-column entries to complete column-wise coverage of a predeclared 90-column corridor, preserving no-attribution/conflict/truncation states and separated dashes. Exact row sets and disagreements can advance the source inventory beyond repeated rectangular locators.
genuine_progress.limitation: Completion of the table is useful only if each represented block was actually inspected and membership was not copied, propagated through gaps/crossings, or expanded from boxes by default.
genuine_progress.prior_failure_lesson: The prior report describes materially different core/fringe interpretations even when outer sets coincide. The corridor must continue to preserve these distinctions; larger coverage does not calibrate the earlier uncertainty.

required_implementation_clarifications.topic: Sparse display and actual observation coverage
required_implementation_clarifications.requirement: When sparse text is used, test that reconstructing omitted coordinates as exactly (255,255,255) reproduces every raw context cell, with no duplicate/missing nonwhite coordinates or altered triples. Record exact consecutive blocks actually read, and keep the complete 8272-cell context source.
required_implementation_clarifications.failure_rule: A truncated, missing or uninspected block is a reading/display failure or incomplete coverage, not 'no_attributable_cells'. Do not populate precise row sets from unavailable output merely to reach 180 records.
required_implementation_clarifications.scope: No extra historical image region or threshold rule is requested; this verifies the protocol's existing lossless-display claim.

required_implementation_clarifications.topic: Old/new overlap comparison has different row coverage
required_implementation_clarifications.requirement: Compare old and new annotations only on common observed pixel cells: old solid columns 300..305, rows 32..48; old dash columns 300..307, rows 4..14. Preserve the unrestricted new sets separately and explicitly report new membership outside those old row ranges.
required_implementation_clarifications.failure_rule: Do not count an old-uninspected cell as an old background/exclusion decision, or call new outside-box membership a contradictory old annotation. The old and new fragments' provisional route association must remain disclosed.
required_implementation_clarifications.scope: This is a fair consistency comparison of retained records, not permission to overwrite old annotations or silently widen their original scope.

other_limits: Reader-local dash identifiers organize each reader's islands. Different literal names are not identity disagreement; identical names are not proof of the same dash. Reconciliation must preserve pixel/route associations and local identifiers rather than automatically merge them.

A cell tentatively assigned to competing routes at an identity conflict must remain a disclosed alternative, not be forced into one route to maintain order or counted as independent support for both. Core/fringe disjointness is an intra-entry requirement, not a reason to erase cross-route ambiguity.
Boundary flags should remain visible alongside identity/status information; target and strip edges are not physical endpoints. No seam join or route propagation across a crossing is admitted.

The two readers can share the same missed edge or incorrect route assignment. Core/union agreement does not recover the original vector stroke, calibrate a pixel radius, or establish continuous model-specific support.

The current human gate does not require a new generic human approval merely to prepare these provisional annotations. It also does not permit their automatic promotion into accepted selected coordinates or consequential model comparisons.
All fourteen pairs and 42 paired quantile slots remain required by the parent scope. This corridor neither completes F3 as a physical curve nor replaces the remaining support/uncertainty inventory.

tests_and_stop.prospective_test_assessment: The inherited exact membership, malformed input, holes/disjoint sets, classification-disagreement, pin and overwrite controls plus repeated reconciliation and separate raw-cell/set checks are proportionate. Add or make explicit the two cases above when implementing the new display/overlap path.
tests_and_stop.verification_ceiling: Successful validation establishes faithful recording, preservation and set arithmetic, not correct stroke identity or an uncertainty envelope for the original line.
tests_and_stop.execution_not_verified: No driver, synthetic tests, annotation, reconciliation or historical pixel reading has been executed or checked by this reviewer in this task.
tests_and_stop.stopping_point: Finish the declared corridor once, retaining unresolved outcomes. If attribution is not useful or stable, report that limit and the precise missing expertise/source arrays rather than continuing indefinite smaller-box or threshold experiments.
tests_and_stop.excluded_inferences: No physical ordinate, support interval, centerline, calibrated uncertainty, quantile selection, model discrepancy, clock, cause, solver, accepted engine state, human acceptance, legal promotion or external action.
